# art-card



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

Card — shadcn/ui parity. A bordered surface with an optional header (title, description,
action), content and footer. Regions render only when their slot is filled, so a card with
just content has no empty header or footer space.

## Slots

| Slot            | Description                           |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------- |
|                 | Content.                              |
| `"action"`      | Top-right action (a button, a badge). |
| `"description"` | Text under the title.                 |
| `"footer"`      | Footer row (buttons).                 |
| `"title"`       | Heading (`<h3 slot="title">`).        |


## Shadow Parts

| Part        | Description                    |
| ----------- | ------------------------------ |
| `"card"`    | The surface.                   |
| `"content"` | The default slot wrapper.      |
| `"footer"`  | The footer row.                |
| `"header"`  | Title, description and action. |
